script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The text does not say the travelers declined to wait for a perfect plan.
The claim about the crew's earlier travels needs a reference outside this passage.
The text does not say nobody marched off the boat.
Cargo is not all the passage tells us was aboard: the travelers boarded the ship.
The dinner comparison mentions food outside the permitted cookie-making context.
Calling the gathering the whole church goes beyond the text's description of the disciples who accompanied them.
The claim that Paul had already left Ephesus needs a reference outside this passage.
Agabus came down from Judea; the text does not say he was from Judea.
The text does not say Philip's belt stayed on him.
The claim about the Philistines being Israel's enemies needs a reference outside this passage.
The text does not give love as the reason the people pleaded with Paul.
Paul does not mention an escape plan, but the text does not establish that he had none.
The text does not say the disciples who accompanied the travelers had heard Agabus.
The text does not say the Ephesian elders were back in Ephesus or establish that none joined this part of the journey.
The claim that Paul had spoken to the Ephesian elders needs a reference outside this passage.
